part.text:
Built a TypeScript static site generator CLI:

- **`src/frontmatter.ts`** — parses `---`-delimited YAML frontmatter with a hand-written key:value splitter (supports quoted strings, booleans, numbers, `[a, b]` arrays, and comma-separated `tags`), merged over gray-matter's output as instructed.
- **`src/markdown.ts`** — renders Markdown body content to HTML via `marked`.
- **`src/build.ts`** — reads `.md` files from the content dir, builds a `Page` per file (title/date/tags fallback to filename slug), writes one HTML file per page plus an `index.html` listing all pages.
- **`src/templates.ts`** — HTML templates with escaping.
- **`src/cli.ts`** — `commander`-based CLI: `ssg build --content <dir> --output <dir>` (defaults `./content` / `./dist`).
- **`tests/`** — 18 Jest tests covering frontmatter parsing, markdown rendering, the build pipeline (file discovery, page generation, index generation, missing-dir errors), and the CLI itself (spawned as a real subprocess via `ts-node` to test actual argv/flag/default-path behavior).

Verified with a real `npm run build` + `node dist-bin/cli.js build` run producing correct `dist/index.html` and `dist/hello.html`.
